answer: Bindings are kept in dawn, verified in delta, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the karst check. A farm of 3208 identities would post 4044 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
